name: Current-state inventory and gap analysis
deliverable: A version-pinned capability inventory and migration-safe extension map
implementation: Inspect actual Potbot APIs, PostgreSQL migrations, Cog registry, Syn catalog, sandbox profiles, credentials, jobs, REST, WebSocket, models and CI; record implemented vs unqualified vs missing; identify safe extension points.
acceptance: Inventory matches pinned main commit; each existing service has an integration owner; no duplicate database or identity subsystem proposed; undocumented assumptions flagged.
demonstration: Generate an inventory JSON and cross-reference report from the checked-out repository.

name: Canonical semantic type and Cog contracts
deliverable: Versioned semantic schemas for tool, capability, implementation, installation, invocation and evidence
implementation: Extend authoritative Syn/Synny Types using full syn:// or synny:// URIs; preserve inherited/default/required/optional Ember contracts; distinguish discovery descriptor from installed executable instance; represent typed input/output via one-input/one-output Cog or typed envelope; bind handler revisions and hashes.
acceptance: Reject shorthand Type identifiers; reject unknown/unregistered data Type refs, invalid inheritance and Ember violations; detect incompatible schema evolution; serialize/deserialize deterministically.
demonstration: Round-trip a SearchQuery → SearchResults Cog and a tool invocation receipt.

name: Execution envelope and provenance contracts
deliverable: Signed, immutable invocation/result/receipt envelope and lifecycle schema
implementation: Define job, run, invocation, input/output artifact hash, policy revision, executor version, causal parent, status, units, budgets, approval, redaction and external source provenance; use Potbot immutable receipts and event conventions. Standardize one pinned, typed syn://event/<id> occurrence for every workflow/model/tool start, update, output, nested call and terminal state; require the exact semantic Type/version, unique process run ID, initiating process/input artifact and SHA-256, authenticated direct trigger, emitter, causal parent, timestamps, and private/redacted parameter projections. Broaden syn://event causation envelopes to EVERY admitted agent work unit: agent/sub-agent, MCP server/session/tool/workflow, ordinary tool, Cog, model, browser/API/SQL, local script, CI, queue and maintenance jobs. Each emitted occurrence carries a registered exact subject Type/version, distinct run/attempt ID, authenticated direct trigger and emitter, and private input artifact digest.
acceptance: Canonical hashes stable on repeat; altered inputs or policy revision invalidate reuse; partial execution never appears verified; payloads over size limits are rejected. Every event—including progress/console/completion—has a resolvable cause and emitter; reject orphan, self-causal, cross-workspace, wrong-release, forged-input and unversioned event records; verify deterministic lineage and output receipts. Cross-protocol fixtures reject any tool/MCP/Cog/internal-job event without exact type/version, unique child run ID, root/parent input and authenticated emitter; no scope exemption for an unfamiliar job kind.
demonstration: Replay an immutable read-only invocation and inspect the linked receipt chain. Replay a typed workflow-to-model-to-tool causal chain from a user input to each child run and its output receipt. Inspect an end-to-end agent job spawning a model, MCP tool workflow, plain CLI tool, Cog and nested agent, with distinct causal event/run identities.

name: Build matrix and stage acceptance harness
deliverable: Stage-aware CI, disposable integration services and machine-readable gate reports
implementation: Use existing uv lock, Python 3.12, scripts/check.py and GitHub CI; add fast offline tests, real PostgreSQL, qualified Linux Bubblewrap/seccomp, contract/fuzz and optional live-provider gates; publish JUnit/JSON and skipped-gate reasons.
acceptance: Fail if mandated DB/sandbox suite skipped; never treat synthetic fixtures as live qualification; prove migration compatibility; preserve all existing test suites.
demonstration: One command produces a P01 gate report and a reproducible failing negative test.

name: MCP stdio adapter
deliverable: Fully tested stdio MCP client for curated servers
implementation: Implement protocol negotiation, tool/resource/prompt enumeration, argument validation, results/content blocks, cancellation, progress, logging, pagination and failure normalization using an official SDK rather than hand-coded wire protocols; pin server packages. Instrument MCP stdio server-process lifetimes, discovery, tool/resource/prompt operations and MCP-composed tool workflows as individual typed agent jobs. Bind server/install digest, negotiated version, MCP session/request ID, controller-minted invocation run ID, caller trigger and child progress/result/console callbacks.
acceptance: Fixture MCP server passes discovery, calls, tool errors, pagination, server crash, oversized payload and cancellation tests; blocked tools cannot be called by guessing IDs. MCP request IDs reused in separate sessions cannot collide; every stdio tool, prompt, resource and composite-workflow step has a unique run, durable start/update/terminal events and verified parent input, with secret-safe output.
demonstration: Invoke a local calculator MCP server in a confined workspace. Stream a model-initiated MCP stdio workflow with two nested tools, distinct session/server/request IDs, callback progress and terminal receipts.

name: MCP Streamable HTTP and authorization
prerequisites: T02.1,T01.3; security design review before remote calls
deliverable: Remote MCP transport with authenticated resource-scoped access
implementation: Support target protocol version 2026-07-28 and negotiate compatibility for earlier supported versions; implement stateless request flow, multi-round-trip where applicable, transport timeouts, header routing, server identity, OAuth protected-resource metadata, scope checks and token audience validation. Extend the same canonical execution-event envelope to remote MCP Streamable HTTP sessions, MCP tool workflows and server-initiated progress notifications; correlate transport session, local invocation, provider callback and authenticated parent run without granting authority to remote identifiers.
acceptance: Mismatched protocol fails clearly; expired/wrong-audience OAuth token rejected; untrusted redirects blocked; 401/403 and disconnect produce correct statuses; reconnect does not repeat writes. MCP HTTP reconnect/cancellation, reused remote request IDs, stale sessions and forged parent callbacks cannot invent runs or duplicate terminal events; each authorized attempt has causal replay.
demonstration: Call a controlled remote read-only MCP endpoint using scoped OAuth test credentials. Replay remote MCP workflow tool calls across reconnect with nested child run IDs and no cross-session collisions.

name: CLI and local process adapters
deliverable: Typed CLI/process adapter running only through approved executors
implementation: Add allowlisted executable identities, argument schemas, stdin/stdout/stderr caps, workdir mapping, exit status and resource limits; reuse qualified Potbot Bubblewrap rather than unrestricted shell access. Emit causal typed process/tool events for each local CLI, script and subprocess run including immutable argv/input hash, sandbox/worker identity, stdout/stderr chunk source, exit/signal, child process relationships and resource/time measurements where available.
acceptance: Reject arbitrary host executable, paths outside registered workspace, shell injection and environment leakage; kill child process trees at timeout; stream bounded progress. Every launched process has a distinct run and provenance chain; outputs cannot be attributed to another PID/lease, and unobserved resource quantities remain unavailable rather than zero.
demonstration: Run git status, python -V and a controlled failing command from workspace tooling. Inspect a shell-independent local CLI execution and child subprocess with streamed console data and exact parent/tool invocation IDs.

name: HTTP, SDK, GraphQL and gRPC adapters
deliverable: Common schema-checked API adapter framework
implementation: OpenAPI request/response validation, HTTP pagination and rate limits, JSON Schema, streaming responses; optional GraphQL introspection and gRPC reflection; map API operations into precise semantic Types and side-effect categories. Instrument REST, SDK, GraphQL and gRPC tool adapters with typed execution runs for each actual call/attempt, approved method/version, request/input receipt, external correlation ID, redacted progress and final status; connect follow-on agent/MCP jobs as child runs.
acceptance: Malformed schemas, hostile redirects, unbounded pagination, malformed response bodies and timeout retry paths fail safely; idempotent reads cache correctly; writes are never blindly retried. Every API operation has an authenticated invoking process and a locally unique run ID; remote IDs cannot spoof causes, repeated writes never auto-retry, and failure/unknown receipts remain distinct.
demonstration: Use a mocked versioned REST service and a real local GraphQL/gRPC fixture. Trace a single agent request through GraphQL, gRPC and a child MCP tool with reproducible causal/output receipts.

name: Capability permission and risk policy
deliverable: Policy decision service with explainable authorization
implementation: Define read, external disclosure, file mutation, network, DB write, code execution, money and admin capability tiers; bind policy to agent identity, wallet hierarchy, workspace, tool instance and user/operator grants; integrate existing security-lock Cog semantics.
acceptance: Default deny; parent grant cannot be broadened by child; privilege escalation by modifying tool metadata rejected; deny decisions logged without leaking secrets.
demonstration: Show authorized search and denied cloud-delete operations for same agent.

name: Workspace and network confinement
deliverable: Enforced filesystem/network boundary for local and remote tool tasks
implementation: Reuse immutable registered sandbox root; all models/tools/dependencies/artifacts/cache inside root; Linux Bubblewrap/seccomp for local untrusted execution; broker egress by hostname/IP with DNS pinning and SSRF protection; Windows/macOS require separately qualified VM/container backend or fail closed.
acceptance: Traversal, symlink, junction, mount, /proc leakage, localhost metadata probing and redirect-to-internal-IP are denied; host files cannot be read/written; unqualified platform cannot run untrusted workloads.
demonstration: Adversarial fixture attempts workspace escape and forbidden network destinations.

name: Credential broker and identity integration
deliverable: Non-exportable scoped credential acquisition and usage
implementation: Extend current OS credential/native broker; preserve public Ed25519 verification keys and private-key custody; use scoped OAuth where available and short-lived provider credentials; never put bearer secrets in model context, tool receipts or logs; categorize passkeys/TPM/hardware as future qualified backends.
acceptance: Secret scanner finds no credentials in traces/artifacts; incorrect identity/recipient rejected; child tool cannot read broker storage; key rotation invalidates stale rights; no unsupported custody profile claims.
demonstration: Call an authenticated test API while the agent sees only an opaque credential handle.

name: Durable tool gateway and approvals
deliverable: First end-to-end authorized tool runner
implementation: Add invocation admission, budget reservation, durable queue claim/lease fencing, immutable result, approval handshake, cancellation, reconciliation and side-effect-aware retries via existing PostgreSQL jobs; preserve typed Cog separation: transforming data does not authorize external execution. Record fenced start/progress/output/tool-invocation/completion/failure events transactionally with actual dispatch/admission decisions; require the trigger process or input, lease generation, typed run and authorization identity on each event. Preserve existing job_events/evidence_events and shared workspace cursor semantics. Enforce one controller-owned event-emission boundary across ALL admitted jobs: regular tools, MCP operations/workflows, subagents, Cogs, browser/API/DB, scheduled/CI/internal jobs and models. Transactionally bind dispatch authorization, actor/worker lease, root trigger, child attempts, terminal results and immutable evidence; unknown writes remain indeterminate.
acceptance: 100 simulated worker crashes result in no unauthorized repeat of side-effecting call; concurrent claims do not double execute; denied approval means zero side effects; read-only invocations replay safely. A denied, unleased or stale-generation execution cannot emit a valid start/completion or forged causal reference; duplicate or uncertain side effects remain un-replayed and explicit. 100% of admitted cross-protocol work has authorized queued/start/outcome events and each update is attributable; denied/expired/stale workers cannot publish false execution or fabricated child events.
demonstration: An operator approves a restricted tool invocation from CLI/API; job/receipt appears in WebSocket replay. Follow an approved tool's start, progress, child invocation and terminal events by immutable run ID; reject a spoofed trigger. Show denied, running and completed ordinary-tool/MCP/Cog/internal jobs from one parent agent timeline, without duplicating effects.

name: Curated registry and trusted package catalog
deliverable: Local signed/version-pinned capability and adapter catalog
implementation: Provide declarative manifest for name, versions, protocol, origin, trust tier, scopes, schemas, SemVer, hashes/SBOM, update policy and dependencies; separate catalog listing from installation/execution.
acceptance: Unpinned or unsigned high-risk package rejected by policy; stale manifest flagged; malicious package cannot gain network/filesystem grants by self-description.
demonstration: List and inspect 20 curated adapters without installing all dependencies.

name: MCP discovery, rescan and schema reconciliation
deliverable: Incremental MCP search and dynamic catalog updates
implementation: Discover enabled server toolsets, tools/resources/prompts, listChanged events, pagination, schemas and supported versions; cache with TTL/revision; ingest third-party MCP registry metadata as untrusted candidates pending operator admission.
acceptance: Discovery is deterministic across reconnects; tool removal invalidates planner references; changed schema requires revalidation; list pagination returns every permitted tool.
demonstration: Add a fake MCP tool during an active session; see tool appear without restarting the agent.

name: Capability search and routing
deliverable: Semantic + symbolic selector with cost/security filtering
implementation: Build keyword, graph and vector search over type hierarchy, metadata and examples; rank by required data types, trust, scopes, observed quality, latency and cost; expose inspect/select and alternative suggestions; lazy-load only relevant tool definitions.
acceptance: A golden set of 40 requests routes to expected capability class; permission-disallowed option never ranks as executable; cold discovery bounded by token/tool budget.
demonstration: Ask for screenshot inspection, satisfiability solving and commit inspection without naming vendors.

name: Versioning, health, revocation and install lifecycle
deliverable: Operator lifecycle APIs and circuit breakers
implementation: Install/uninstall/pin/up/downgrade adapters inside workspace tools/; healthcheck schema/runtime compatibility; quarantine compromised packages, recall capability revisions and invalidate stale invocations.
acceptance: Rolling update preserves old active runs; revoked instance is denied immediately to new calls; rollback restores previous manifest without corrupting receipts; health state is visible.
demonstration: Disable a known-bad test tool during queued invocations and verify safe behavior.

name: Search provider adapters and result normalization
deliverable: Multi-provider search capability with source timestamps
implementation: Integrate Google via supported licensed API/provider, Brave, Bing where supported, and Tavily/Exa or comparable providers; credentials brokered; normalized query, ranked results, snippet, retrieval time, canonical URL, source engine and quota; do not assume Google public website is a stable API.
acceptance: Mocked quota failure falls back when policy allows; duplicates deduplicated but source lineage retained; restricted result providers cannot silently exfiltrate sensitive queries.
demonstration: Compare two providers for a technical research query and save independent result sets.

name: Fetch, extraction and canonical source artifacts
deliverable: Web fetch/crawler with robust content provenance
implementation: HTTP fetch with robots/terms/rate constraints; structured HTML/JSON extraction; PDF/document parser, tables, code and metadata; redirects canonicalized; content-addressed copies with extraction versions; optional OCR only on scanned material.
acceptance: Correctly extracts authored text from HTML, PDF and JSON fixtures; preserves citation spans and source hashes; rejects zip bombs, huge pages and private-network redirects.
demonstration: Follow search results and answer with verifiable document-location citations.

name: Specialist scientific and archival retrieval
deliverable: Domain source connectors with query contracts
implementation: Add Crossref, OpenAlex, arXiv, PubMed, Semantic Scholar (subject to API availability), Wikidata/SPARQL and Internet Archive; record primary vs secondary source and publication/event date separately.
acceptance: DOI resolution and duplicate author/title matching work; retractions/corrections represented; unsupported endpoints degrade explicitly; rate-limits respected.
demonstration: Retrieve a paper and its linked metadata from two independent sources.

name: Evidence comparison and research workflows
deliverable: Reproducible research workflow and contradiction matrix
implementation: Build claim/source/evidence triples, corroboration, temporal validity, independence, contradiction flags and cited answer assembly; stop with uncertainty rather than inventing verification.
acceptance: Planted conflicting claims produce an unresolved state; old news not mislabeled current; every quoted claim has traceable source offsets; zero fabricated citations in gold fixture.
demonstration: Research a contested technical specification and show supported vs unresolved claims.

name: Playwright controlled browser service
deliverable: Managed isolated browser sessions via Playwright MCP/CLI
implementation: Install browser runtimes within allowed workspace tool assets; use isolated profiles, accessibility snapshots, navigation, screenshots, forms, controlled downloads/uploads and deterministic session replay; persistent profiles opt-in and separately partitioned.
acceptance: Two workspaces cannot read each others cookies; malicious webpage instructions cannot authorize new tool calls; downloads remain under workspace; session recovery does not invent form submission status.
demonstration: Automate an internal test application from login through read-only dashboard export.

name: Chrome DevTools and network debugger
deliverable: CDP-based debugging and performance capability
implementation: Integrate Chrome DevTools MCP for console errors, network waterfall, trace, coverage, heap/performance and DOM/AX inspection; bind traces to run receipts; disable unintended data sharing/telemetry when required.
acceptance: Captures and attributes a deliberately failing request; rejects debugger connection outside permitted sessions; large traces redacted and bounded.
demonstration: Locate a simulated CORS, 404 or frontend JavaScript failure.

name: Visual regression, accessibility and desktop fallback
deliverable: Multimodal browser result and UI test adapters
implementation: Create image diff, screenshots, DOM/AX cross-check, semantic interaction and layout regression snapshots; optional native desktop automation only in qualified isolated VMs; prioritize structured UI before coordinate clicks.
acceptance: Detect known 1-pixel/large-layout regressions with tuned thresholds; keyboard-only path tested; false-positive baseline reported; no raw browser profile credentials exported.
demonstration: Compare UI screenshots and explain visually detected vs DOM-detected changes.

name: Browser reliability benchmark and test fixtures
deliverable: Browser action benchmark with deterministic replay
implementation: Build local fixture site for auth, forms, redirects, pagination, downloads, popups, slow response and malicious prompt content; run Playwright, CLI and optional alternative engines on identical tasks; report outcome, context tokens, elapsed time and costs.
acceptance: >=95% deterministic success on own stable fixture at pinned environment after agreed retries; zero unauthorized form submissions; reproducible traces for every failed case.
demonstration: Dashboard of browser methods and sample CI artifact.

name: GitHub and GitLab integration
deliverable: Repository-host adapters with scoped tools
implementation: Integrate GitHub MCP official server, REST fallback for missing operations and optional GitLab/Gitea; repo/PR/issue/commit/actions read APIs; write scopes and approval requests explicit; webhook and polling options.
acceptance: Read-only PAT cannot create PR; pagination complete; webhook replays deduplicated; pull request operations bound to exact branch and current revision.
demonstration: Read failing GitHub Actions log and create a proposed issue draft in test repo.

name: Local Git, AST and LSP intelligence
deliverable: Source-aware repository exploration
implementation: Integrate git status/diff/log/blame, ripgrep, Tree-sitter, ast-grep, LSP symbol/ref/diagnostics; cache against immutable source snapshot; never mutate original host repository.
acceptance: Rename/function reference lookup correct in fixtures; stale index invalidated on git commit; path outside workspace denied; binary and malformed files handled safely.
demonstration: Locate definition, usages and tests of a method and produce a navigation graph.

name: Build/test/static/security toolchain
deliverable: Normalized verification runner
implementation: Use uv-managed pytest and language-specific tests, lint, types, formatting, Semgrep/CodeQL where available, OSV/Trivy/Syft and configurable SBOM; record exit codes, commands, tool versions, environment digests and logs.
acceptance: A planted vulnerability/test failure is detected; changed test definition invalidates prior success; absence of mandatory checker fails; no secret in logs; no automatic network dependency download unless allowed.
demonstration: Run verified code quality profile against a controlled faulty sample project.

name: Safe patch/PR/CI closure workflow
deliverable: Artifact-bound proposed changes with CI feedback loop
implementation: Re-use Potbot existing baseline→candidate→patch→exact-state-check→manifest pipeline; commit on isolated branch, open draft PR when approved, poll CI/replay events and assemble results; no autonomous merge by default.
acceptance: Wrong base hash or stale contract blocks write; required checks cannot be deleted to pass; fake CI success rejected; branch creation/write requires explicit scope; output includes patch provenance.
demonstration: Repair a failing fixture, open draft PR in test repository and record CI outcome.

name: Safe SQL and analytical data adapters
deliverable: PostgreSQL, SQLite and DuckDB read/query interfaces
implementation: Use existing owner-separated PostgreSQL store; separate user/workspace query connection from internal persistence; prepared statements, schema introspection, read-only transactions by default, row/output caps, explain plan, cost guardrails; DuckDB loads workspace files only.
acceptance: RLS cross-workspace query fails; SQL injection and multi-statement mutation rejected; explain cost-limit works; raw DSN never exposed; queries interrupted on budget.
demonstration: Query workspace-owned fixture and join CSV/Parquet with DuckDB.

name: Vector, full-text and graph retrieval
deliverable: Hybrid retrieval and semantic graph capability
implementation: Extend current pgvector/named embeddings, full-text and relationship types; plug in Neo4j/Kuzu/Qdrant only when justified; implement citations and source snapshot scoping, identity and revision filters.
acceptance: Cross-tenant leakage absent under 100 adversarial queries; wrong embedding model revision cannot silently mix vectors; graph traversal respects max depth; search results reproduce from snapshot.
demonstration: Return semantic and structural matches for a coding question.

name: Schema-aware external API integration
deliverable: API catalog generated from OpenAPI/GraphQL/gRPC schemas
implementation: Map API methods to capability and cog contracts, generate typed request models, validate response, paginate/resume and classify read vs write vs destructive operations; store provider schema hash and refresh diff.
acceptance: Breaking API schema change blocks invocation until requalified; rate-limit fallback emits status; idempotency-key write behavior validated; provider errors correctly mapped.
demonstration: Import OpenAPI spec and perform safe request using generated capability.

name: Cloud, files, collaboration and optional services
deliverable: Policy-controlled specialist connector profile
implementation: Provide adapters/connector templates for S3-compatible object stores, Google Drive/SharePoint, Slack/Teams, GitHub Releases, Docker/Kubernetes/cloud control planes, Unity/Blender and domain tools; prioritize need rather than auto-install; privileged operations behind approval.
acceptance: Each added connector passes standard contract suite; unavailable authorization reported accurately; cloud destructive action denied by default; cross-workspace secrets isolated.
demonstration: Enable one chosen optional connector from registry and run qualification script.

name: Python, statistics and symbolic computation
deliverable: Reasoning compute profile with Python/NumPy/SciPy/SymPy
implementation: Provide typed operations for exact algebra, calculus, numerical experiments, statistics, plots and reproducible notebooks/scripts; include input dataset hashes, versions, numerical tolerances and execution environment; external code strictly sandboxed.
acceptance: Curated numeric/symbolic gold tasks meet exact/tolerance targets; NaN/overflow/ill-conditioned cases flagged; independent recomputation matches receipts; no untrusted wheel network install.
demonstration: Solve sample analytical task both symbolically and numerically.

name: SMT, optimization and counterexamples
deliverable: Z3/cvc5 and OR-Tools reasoning capabilities
implementation: Translate typed constraints and problem instances into bounded SMT/CP-SAT jobs; expose satisfiable, unsatisfiable, unknown and timeout distinctly; request models/counterexamples, unsat cores and objective bounds when available.
acceptance: Known SAT/UNSAT suites return correct outcome; timeout never recast as UNSAT; no untrusted solver expressions executed as Python; constraint model provenance retained.
demonstration: Identify contradiction in cryptographic key-rotation rules and show counterexample.

name: Wolfram, domain mathematics and simulation
deliverable: Advanced computational backend with fallbacks
implementation: Integrate Wolfram via supported API/MCP where authorized, local SageMath/Julia or domain simulation as optional profiles; compare answer consistency with SymPy/numerical solver; distinguish computational result from tool-generated natural-language explanation.
acceptance: No paid API calls without budget authorization; inconsistent symbolic results trigger verification; units/dimensional checks pass; reproducibility report notes external provider version.
demonstration: Compute same integral or optimization using two backends and compare.

name: Formal proof and model checking
deliverable: Proof-checking and state-machine analysis profile
implementation: Integrate Lean 4, TLA+/Apalache/Alloy (qualified tools) for invariants, temporal behavior and counterexample traces; encode specs, preserve assumptions, run kernel/checker separately; no claim that arbitrary code is proven by example tests.
acceptance: One true theorem checked, one deliberately false theorem rejected; flawed state-machine exposes counterexample; missing proof treated unverified; proof artifact retains checker revision.
demonstration: Check no-double-dispatch invariant on a simplified tool queue state machine.

name: Composable typed Cog workflow planner
deliverable: Type-directed workflow graph assembler
implementation: Infer typed routes from capability input/output contracts, selecting explicitly installed Cogs and data converters; support fan-out/fan-in via typed envelope nodes; reject cycles unless loop bounds and termination guard explicitly supplied; explain plan and required rights before executing. Compile typed workflow and Cog dataflow nodes into exact per-node run identities and immutable triggering input/parent-event edges. Explicitly represent MCP-composed workflow steps, nested subagents, tool adapters and fan-in contributing input sources.
acceptance: 50 golden dataflow cases compile; incompatible types rejected; cycles without bounds rejected; every edge carries immutable type/version; unauthorized transform cannot trigger a tool. Every graph node's initiating event or input artifact resolves, including multiple fan-in sources; no synthesized sole parent, orphan Cogs or implicit privilege from type conversion.
demonstration: Compose SearchQuery → Pages → Claims → VerifiedReport without naming specific adapters. Display a typed workflow graph combining MCP nested tool calls, Cogs and a delegated sub-agent, with fully resolved causal inputs.

name: Durable parallel workflow runtime
deliverable: Resumable DAG executor and event stream
implementation: Extend existing PostgreSQL queue/REST/WebSocket jobs with graph node scheduling, deduplication, lease fences, bounded concurrency, pause/resume, approval handoff, checkpointing and compensation proposals; avoid replaying uncertain non-idempotent effects. Instrument workflow DAG nodes and nested model/tool processes with unique run IDs, immutable input snapshots and parent syn://event causation; emit lifecycle, safe console output and progress events via the existing durable cursor, and retain finished/indeterminate metrics, tool-run links and typed output artifacts. Extend the durable DAG executor and shared workspace event cursor to every agent-executed work type, not merely models/tools: nested agents, MCP sessions/composite workflows, Cogs, CLI/browser/API/DB, CI and internal scheduled jobs. Track each start/update/child/terminal event, fan-out/fan-in ancestry, retries and indeterminate remote effects.
acceptance: Kill workers at 5 fault points and require no double side effects; event cursor replay identical after restart; fan-in waits for all required verified inputs; budget exhaustion halts safely. Every nested execution is traceable to its parent process or exact input through restart/replay; no missing parent, duplicated event, false completion or repeated side effect; terminal events carry measured/estimated/unknown wall time and resource metrics. Mixed MCP/model/Cog/subagent workflows replay an identical causal tree after crash/reconnect; no duplicate side effects, lost terminal state or inferred provider completion; distinct run and child-attempt identities survive restart.
demonstration: Run fan-out multi-source research workflow with injected worker crash. Stream a parallel workflow live, inspect the exact input/process triggering every event, reconnect from the last cursor and expand its model/tool run tree. Stream a fan-out agent workflow with model→MCP→API and Cog→sub-agent branches and inspect each recorded cause and resource/output receipt.

name: Model reasoning controller and independent critics
deliverable: Tool-aware reasoning and independent challenge workflow
implementation: Extend existing multi-model selection, provider gateway and Phase 6 graph/search instead of creating competing planner; add tool proposals with confidence/uncertainty, bounded alternative plan search, independent verifier role, contradiction tests and grounded action selection. Emit version-pinned model and critic start/progress/output/completion events with independent run identifiers, triggering workflow/context packet, provider/deployment revision, elapsed clock time, tokens, CPU/GPU/memory where observable, cost and all nested external tool run IDs. Correlate every model/critic call and its requested ordinary or MCP tools with exact parent reasoning/workflow input, model invocation identity, downstream MCP server/session/tool IDs, child agent runs and full terminal usage/output accounting.
acceptance: Planted false claims challenged, unsupported conclusions labeled; reviewer cannot self-approve writes; no added model call bypasses budget; role context isolation passes. Each local or hosted model event has an authenticated causal input and exact selected model/deployment identity; unavailable provider revisions and resource measurements remain explicitly unknown, never invented or zero-filled. A model-triggered MCP workflow has independently typed server/tool/subtool/agent events; provider tool-call IDs are never used as untrusted global run identities, and each completion lists observed child receipts.
demonstration: Run same coding problem with and without tool/critic loop and compare verified outcomes. Trace two distinct reasoning/coding model runs and their external tool invocations with different model revisions and independent accounting receipts. Trace a reasoning model calling an MCP search workflow that calls an API tool and another model, including each trigger and unique run ID.

name: Adaptive selection, caching and capability utility
prerequisites: T10.3; offline utility fixture (expanded by T11.1)
deliverable: Policy-safe empirically learned router
implementation: Collect per-task-family success, cost, latency, failure and context usage; choose by permissions and expected utility, back off on poor health, allow manual override and deterministic baseline; cached responses must respect exact source/credential/revision scope.
acceptance: Forced override honored; no unqualified tool promoted automatically; wrong-scope cache never served; with evidence insufficient route remains baseline rather than inventing performance gain.
demonstration: Display a tool-selection decision explanation and its evidence.

name: Representative task benchmark suite
deliverable: Versioned baseline/gold dataset and blind task splits
implementation: Assemble Potbot/DanceFlow real tasks plus web, browser, API, SQL, math, formal proof and adverse cases; keep authored fixtures distinct from held-out and actual provider runs; immutable baseline and scorer revisions.
acceptance: At least 20 tasks per target domain to start with explicit difficulty and expected observable outcome; benchmark contamination checked; each outcome independently scored.
demonstration: Produce model-only versus single-tool versus composite-tool comparison report.

name: Evidence integrity and factual verification
deliverable: Evidence checker and provenance audit
implementation: Implement immutable citations, external source hashes, assertion→support mapping, independent execution checks, source freshness, contradictory evidence and replay audit; integrate with patch verification and solver result retention. Audit every syn://event occurrence against the exact triggering process/input, parent event, workspace, typed semantic release, run/lease generation, output hash, terminal metrics provenance and external tool receipt chain. Audit universal causal event ancestry across MCP transports, model callbacks, Cogs, browser/API/SQL, nested workers and queued jobs. Verify server/session/request correlation, workspace-scoped run/lease IDs, root input digests, child outcome/usage receipts and one global event-cursor ordering.
acceptance: Tampered citation/patch/proof hash detected; unsupported claims fail; stale docs flagged; reproducible receipts for offline tasks; partial tool success not promoted to verified claim. Tampered parent event or input SHA-256, unregistered Type/version, cross-workspace causal link, forged emitter, missing triggered-by identity or fabricated resource measure fails acceptance. Reject forged MCP callback parents, orphan internal/Cog events, cross-session reused IDs, fan-in input substitution, false child completion and wrong-workspace roots; legacy job-only events stay readable.
demonstration: Show accepted claim, challenged claim and unresolved claim with source chain. Render a verified event ancestry and show a rejected event with a falsified initiating workflow step or source input. Challenge an MCP tool response that attempts to spoof another agent's run and show the rejected causal edge.

name: Statistical evaluation and regression policies
deliverable: Comparable experiments and release regression gates
implementation: Compare model-only, retrieval-only, calculation-only, solver, critic and adaptive configurations; paired task sets, repeated seeds, confidence intervals, pre-registered metrics: verified success, false-pass, tool selection, cost/success, tokens, latency, reliability; budget-adjusted quality.
acceptance: No aggregate metric mixes synthetic with live; baseline regressions fail gate at configured threshold; confidence uncertainty reported; all runs include pinned configs and costs.
demonstration: Generate a CI report showing whether each tool meaningfully improves a target task family.

name: Security, chaos and adversarial qualification
deliverable: Red-team and failure-injection release suite
implementation: Test prompt injection, tool-result laundering, malicious MCP manifests, poisoned document retrieval, SSRF, symlink races, quota exhaustion, replay after crash, dependency compromise, OAuth confusion and cross-tenant leakage.
acceptance: Zero critical successful boundary escapes in gated corpus; kill-switch works during incident; unqualified host fails closed; secrets absent in logs; data destruction requires explicit authorization.
demonstration: Execute attack corpus in disposable CI environment and retain audit evidence.

name: Installation and dependency qualification
deliverable: Reproducible cross-platform deployment profiles
implementation: Use existing start.bat, start.ps1, start.sh and uv lock; provision adapters/models to workspace-local directories; pin all tool binaries, hashes, browsers and packages; optional profiles avoid bloating default; report host sandbox qualification separately.
acceptance: Fresh Linux install passes standard suite; Windows/macOS untrusted execution either passes qualified isolation or fails closed; offline smoke mode works without paid credentials; rollback documented.
demonstration: Run fresh install and capability discovery from clean checkout.

name: Operator UI, monitoring and controls
deliverable: Unified tool dashboard and API surfaces
implementation: Extend current web dashboard/REST/WebSocket with catalog, permissions, health, active DAG, tool calls, prompts/resources, evidence, cost budgets, approvals, audit and diagnostic outputs; filter by workspace. Add workspace-scoped live execution REST read models and resumable WebSocket streams for running workflows, model calls, child tools, typed syn://event history, per-event triggering process/input, timelines, progress, bounded/redacted console, wall time, resource/cost metrics and final output artifact links; retain legacy job clients. Expose one authenticated universal execution API and live WebSocket tree for ALL job kinds: workflows, models, ordinary tools, MCP servers/sessions/tool workflows, agents/subagents, Cogs, scripts, browser/API/DB/CI, scheduler and internal jobs. Include per-event trigger/emitter, exact Type/version, child links, duration/usage and output receipts, preserving legacy /v1/jobs clients.
acceptance: Read-only users cannot approve; replay cursor shows same state after reconnect; all secret fields redacted; API and UI agree on execution status and verification state. API, WebSocket replay and dashboard agree on each event's Type/version, unique run ID, direct cause, emitter, parent-child trace, status and accounting; unauthorized clients cannot access private inputs or cross-workspace events; slow subscribers resume without loss. REST, WebSocket and UI present identical mixed-protocol hierarchical timelines and authorized redacted outputs; one workspace cursor replays job-only plus standalone agent execution events with no omissions after reconnect.
demonstration: Operator inspects running workflow, approves a safe write and sees immutable result. Open the running-workflows dashboard, inspect every start/update/completion, drill into exactly what triggered a model/tool event, and replay the same timeline after reconnecting. Inspect the complete nested model→MCP→tool→Cog→subagent job tree live; filter by kind and click every event to its exact initiating input or process.

name: Developer docs, SDK, examples and migration guides
deliverable: Stable extension SDK and adoption documentation
implementation: Publish semantic Type reference, adapter contract, sample MCP server/client, custom CLI/REST/Cog plug-in templates, version/migration guide, isolation requirements, threat model, troubleshooting and tests; keep existing docs linked and authoritative.
acceptance: External contributor can build a sample adapter following docs; examples run in CI; old project migrations preserve receipts and types; no unpinned download instructions.
demonstration: Create sample custom tool using SDK and pass conformance tests.

name: Release certification and maintenance policy
deliverable: Signed release with acceptance dossier and ongoing change control
implementation: Pin commit, migrations, tools, model configs, execution host qualification, SBOM, security scans and benchmark reports; publish release, downgrade/rollback, compatibility table, deprecation and routine requalification policy; label limitations prominently.
acceptance: All required tests pass on claimed hosts; no known critical security escape; release can be restored and receipts validated; metrics vs prior qualified version reported with no fabricated score.
demonstration: Reproduce full gated demonstration from clean tagged checkout.
